_metadata.assignment: ALPHA+) inserts := in every layout and input style.
_metadata.literalOverrideRule: When an explicit literal is being edited, apply the matching _literalContextOverrides instead of _contextOverrides, directly to the base domain/layout list. REG replaces the entire key list with _registerLayer and ignores radix/input-style contexts.
_metadata.literalPrefixes: ALPHA4 displays b and inserts canonical 0b. ALPHA5 inserts 0x. Explicit ALPHA A-F uses @hexA through @hexF to disambiguate numeric intent. Explicit literal radix overrides result-base digit masks.
_metadata.matrixPrimary: [ opens the dimension chooser in Natural input; in Linear input it inserts the opening bracket.
_metadata.overrideRule: Apply the matching _contextOverrides keys by zero-based keyIndex to the base domain/layout list. Unlisted contexts use the base list unchanged.
_metadata.pocketRelocations: ALPHA multiply x; ALPHA divide y; ALPHA plus canonical argument comma.
_metadata.recurringIcon: 1̅2̅3̅ labels are painted as 123 with one continuous overline.
_metadata.registerLayer: SHIFT+. enters REG in place. R0-R9 replace digits; only . and SHIFT exit. Independent of base/domain/input style; selections stay latched. Escape/context loss cancel. No persistence.
_metadata.source: Generated from CalculatorPanel::keyButtons() and effective KeyDefinition objects.
_metadata.statistics: SHIFT+MENU opens Statistics in Calculator layouts. Desktop opens Statistics from the Toolbox.
